name: effects
title: Effects for Triangle-Like: per-sprite saturation and flash, a screen tint for time-stop and full-screen grey, and recipes for outline, glow and glitch
issue: Design: orchestrator/proposals/effects-design.md (decisions A to H in section 5 await the user). Gap 3 of the Triangle-Like plan. Depends on PR #318 (Sprite2D). Split into stages E1 (sprite colour effects), E2 (screen tint), E3 (optional outline texture helper) once the design is approved; each stage is one PR.
acceptance: Sprite2D and UI Image have saturation and flash, drawn the same on OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU and software; defaults change no existing golden image
A screen tint (saturation inside or outside a screen circle) applies to scene draws only, survives the software renderer's reordering, and leaves the UI untouched
Shader parity tests cover every new uniform; software pixel tests and the Vulkan (lavapipe) tests pass in CI; OpenGL listed as unverified on a GPU
Lua bindings, serialization with old scenes loading unchanged, docs with the recipes for outline, glow and glitch, and web sizes measured
gate: user go on the design (orchestrator/proposals/effects-design.md); do not launch before it
notes: Reviewer: the four shader versions match (OpenGL GLSL strings, Vulkan GLSL, WGSL, software C++), the per-draw tint equals a post-pass tint for blended draws, the UI pass is not tinted, the software renderer's branch is per draw not per pixel, web size budgets.
